asks.text: Caravans pay main LOREBOUND Gold, which is an economy change. Suggestion: OK it for the test site only, with the first shipment paying about the Gold of 5 ordinary enemies at the player's current floor, at most one caravan at a time, and a 10-minute trip that only counts down…

Haven (#92, with #91 and #90) has to be in main first, or at least settled, before caravans can build on it. Suggestion: merge or finish #92 first, then comment "@claude build this now" here.
Spending main Gold on optional Trade upgrades is a new Gold cost. Suggestion: leave it out of the first version and add it later as a separate step.
Which Haven buildings should unlock the first caravan? Suggestion: Workshop plus Survey Post, as the request says.
How many contracts should there be at first? Suggestion: two, a Timber Order (Wood only) and a Mason's Order (Wood and Stone). Ore Supply would come after the first boss.
Should the trip only count down while Haven is open? Suggestion: yes for now. It's simpler and safer, and it stops anyone from getting Gold by changing the phone's clock.
